g.text: P1: more independent parents help, but the classical accuracy gap remains

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Same nine sealed fits on eight diagnostic parents · 5 × 5 periodic FD grid · lower RMS is better
RMS = square root of equally weighted parent MSE. One nested cohort; no confidence intervals.
Cost labels give parent counts. Shared validation, design construction and fitting are excluded; overlapping cell costs are not additive.
